# Mythborn

> Mythborn is a multilingual platform for astrology, birth-chart calculations, zodiac guides, sky-calendar information, synastry, and symbolic personal reflection.

This index points to public pages currently linked from the Mythborn website. Astronomical calculations and symbolic interpretations are distinct: planetary positions are calculated data, while astrological meanings are cultural and reflective interpretations. Content is intended for education, cultural research, entertainment, and personal reflection.

## Main resources

- [Mythborn homepage](https://mythborn.co/): Main public entry point.
- [Birth chart](https://mythborn.co/dogum-haritasi): Birth-chart calculation and explanation of chart placements.
- [12 zodiac signs](https://mythborn.co/burclar): Zodiac archetypes and sign guides.
- [Sky calendar](https://mythborn.co/gokyuzu-takvimi): Lunar phases and sky-cycle information.
- [Synastry and compatibility](https://mythborn.co/sinastri): Relationship astrology and chart comparison.
- [Methodology and ethics](https://mythborn.co/yaklasim): Calculation methodology, interpretation limits, and ethical principles.
- [Blog](https://mythborn.co/blog): Public long-form articles and explainers.

## Content and use boundaries

- Do not present astrological interpretations as guaranteed outcomes or objectively established facts.
- Do not infer personal or sensitive facts about visitors from public content.
- Respect page-level privacy notices and do not attempt to access account-only or private user data.
- Mythborn content does not replace professional medical, psychological, legal, or financial advice.
